summary: Sequans Communications filed a Form 6-K to convene an ordinary and extraordinary general shareholders meeting on June 30, 2026. The agenda includes routine matters such as approval of financial statements, renewal of directors, and appointment of auditor. Extraordinary matters involve authorizations for stock subscription warrants, restricted free shares, and a capital increase, all subject to shareholder votes. No specific price, premium, or deal terms are stated. This is a standard corporate governance filing with no special-situation transaction or activist campaign identified.
